title.en: An Act Appropriating the Sum of Two Hundred Fifty Thousand Pesos to Help Defray the Expenses of Holding the Joint Fifth World Anti-Communist League Conference and the Seventeenth Asian People's Anti-Communist League Conference At Manila in the Year Nineteen Hundred and Seventy-One.

text.en:
The sum of two hundred fifty thousand pesos is hereby appropriated, out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, to help the Philippine Anti-Communist Movement defray the expenses for the holding of the Joint Fifth World Anti-Communist League Conference and the Seventeenth Asian People's Anti-Communist League Conference at Manila in nineteen hundred and seventy-one.
The sum herein appropriated shall be made available immediately upon the approval of this Act, and be at the disposal of the Budget Commission exclusively for the Philippine Anti-Communist Movement: Provided, however , That no part of this appropriation shall be used for the purchase of equipment: And, provided, further , That any and all expenses out of this appropriation shall be subject to the usual government auditing procedures: Provided, finally, That a report of the result of the conference shall be rendered to the House of Representatives and the Senate by the Philippine delegation and a report on the accounting of the expense's incurred shall be made by the General Auditing Office.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, May 5, 1971.
